Last March,  he opened the Robinhood Free Meetinghouse restaurant, outside Bath. 

     Mr. Gagne made his culinary reputation during an eight-year tenure as chef at the nearby Osprey restaurant. At the helm of his own restaurant -- in a restored 1855 Greek Revival-style meetinghouse -- he offers an ambitious nightly menu of  31 appetizers (which include 3 soups, 11 salads and 6 fettuccine dishes), 34 entrees and 12 desserts.
